page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Page number top left, running head top centre. Catchword "Illud" at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: striæ[?], Libertati, cæterisque commodis favent, ut satis interim Regiæ Majestati & Prærogativæ relinquatur; modo Rex fuerit ejusmodi, qui Populum suum pro Subditis non pro Servis habeat; hujusmodi enim subjectione, quemadmodum optimè conservatur Pax eorum & salus & peculiares cujusque proprietatcs, ita nec Jus tuum violabitur nec illa Populi Libertas ingenua, quæ in percipiendis Laboris sui fructibus, Legumque, in quas Ipsi consenserc, beneficio consistit.

Nunquam Caput Tuum premat Corona ejusmodi sub cujus pondere totum Corpus labascat, quod in partibus infirmatum nil jam Capiti vicissim honoris, roboris, Incolumitatis referet, sed debilitari [illegible, ~5 letters] faciet & procumbere.
Optimè Prærogativam tuam exercebis & ostendes si relaxes Legum magis quàm inten-das rigorem, cùm Tyrannide ex Lege agente, nil deterius.

In his duobus præcipuis conservatione Re-ligionis stabilitæ & Legum, puto Me minimè vanum futurum, si dixero probra ista in Me coram Mundo congesta in Martyrii honorem apud Conscientiam meam cessura, cùm hi Re-gni Mei perturbatores nihil aliud fere contra Me afferunt, quàm quod Leges & Religionem Sancitam Novationibus Illorum prætulerim.
Id enim facio revera, & semper faciam dum potioribus argumentis convincar, quàm quibus hactenus Me oppugnârunt Turbis, Præliis, Carceribus.

page.notes: The first word of the page, "striæ", is only partly legible; the first letter is cut off and read as a probable "P" or similar, so it is marked [?]. The word "simul" in the line "debilitari ... faciet" is covered by an ink blot and is marked illegible. Printed misspelling "proprietatcs" is left as printed. The running head is set in mixed Greek and Latin capitals on the scan; it is given here in Greek letters.
